question: Dhivehi is the official language of which neighbouring country of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maldives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Dhivehi** is the official language of the Maldives.
 
• It is an Indo-Aryan language spoken by the Maldivian people.
 
• The language has its roots in the ancient Sinhala language.
 
• Dhivehi is written in the Thaana script, which reads from right to left.</l
